# Andi's Fade Society

> Barbershop based in Austin, Texas. A private one-chair barbershop on East Riverside. Andi listens first, then cuts, and every haircut comes with a free drink, hot towel and neck shave.

- Phone: (985) 474-1624
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, East Riverside, Travis Heights, Montopolis, South Congress, Downtown Austin
- Google rating: 4.9 from 70 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/andis-fade-society/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/andis-fade-society/book.html

## Services
- Haircuts & fades: A quick consultation, then a cut built for you. Every haircut includes a free drink, hot towel and neck shave.
- Curly cuts: Curly hair is one of Andi's specialties: shape and texture up top, clean lines on the sides.
- Scissor cuts & styles: Sharp scissor work for slick-backs, side parts and longer tops.
- Beards & lineups: Trims, shaping and crisp lineups, finished with a hot towel and shave.
- Kids cuts: Clean, comfortable cuts for kids ages 7 to 12.
- Monthly memberships: Stay sharp all month. Memberships bundle your visits into one monthly price.

## About
Andi Brown has been in the barber game for nine years, sharpening the craft through hands-on experience and advanced education. Clean fades, sharp scissor cuts and curly hair are the specialties. Andi's Fade Society is a private suite (Suite 101) at 1600 E Riverside Dr, just south of downtown. One chair, one barber. Every haircut comes with a free drink, a hot towel and a neck shave. In Andi's words: “What really sets me apart is my love for building real relationships with my clients. Every appointment is more than just a haircut, it's an experience.”

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book with Andi?
  A: Book online or call (985) 474-1624. A credit or debit card is required to hold your appointment.
- Q: What comes with a haircut?
  A: Every haircut includes a short consultation, a free drink, a hot towel and a neck shave. A haircut is $50, and first-time clients pay $45.
- Q: Do you cut curly hair?
  A: Yes. Curly hair is one of Andi's specialties, along with clean fades and sharp scissor cuts.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. The Kids Cut is for ages 7 to 12 and is $40.
- Q: What if I'm running late or need to cancel?
  A: There's a 10-minute grace period. Cancellations within 6 hours of your appointment are charged 50%, and no-shows are charged 100%.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: Suite 101 at 1600 E Riverside Dr, Austin, TX 78741, in the South Shore area of East Riverside.
